fantom.aciklama: Detects blue tumor foci in a synthetic kidney phantom; produces a 3D position + PEMF coil / E-field estimate.
fantom.hesaplandi: An electric field (E) falling on cancerous and healthy tissue was calculated for each tumor; the duty settings (D1–D7) of the 7 PEMF coils were produced accordingly.
fantom.ipucuBoy: • The phantom length (cm) is used only if the ring or the cabin marker is not visible
fantom.ipucuHalka: • <kalin>Most of the green coil ring</kalin> should be in the frame — the scale comes from it
fantom.ipucuMavi: • Blue tumor dots should be clearly visible; the phantom should be at least ~300 px in the frame
fantom.ipucuUst: • Photograph the phantom <kalin>straight from above</kalin>, sharp and well lit
fantom.nokta1: A higher E_cancer means the field is more focused on that region.
fantom.nokta2: The D1–D7 bars show each coil's drive ratio (duty %).
fantom.nokta3: 3D coordinate: the position of the tumor center within the scale / cabin frame.

tespitYok.metin: Try again with a sharp, well-lit photo taken from above.

agriYok.metin: No sign of pain or stress is seen in the facial features; the cat looks relaxed.

fgs.bantNotu: The band is the p5–p95 range of the healthy calibration population; a value outside the band is not a diagnosis on its own.

hafif.metin: There may be a mild discomfort or tension. Keep observing; if you wish, you can ease it with PEMF.
hafif.nokta1: Ear / eye / nose / whisker / head position scores are below.
hafif.nokta2: FGS = Feline Grimace Scale (facial pain scale).

fgs.ipucuAydinlatma: • Good lighting — avoid blur or darkness
fgs.ipucuBaslik: 📸 Photo tips for an accurate FGS analysis
fgs.ipucuTekKedi: • One cat, with the face toward the camera
fgs.ipucuYuz: • Photograph the cat's face <kalin>straight on</kalin>, close up and in focus
fgs.ipucuYuzOgeleri: • Eyes, ears, nose and whiskers should be clearly visible

orta.metin: There is noticeable tension in the facial features. Autonomous PEMF therapy can be applied; if the signs last longer than 1–2 days, consult a veterinarian.

siddetli.metin: A serious sign of pain was detected. Contacting a veterinarian without delay is recommended.

yuzYok.metin: The pain score could not be calculated because the cat's face could not be seen clearly. Try again with a clear, well-lit photo taken straight on.

gorsel.gercekZamanliIpucu: Real-time processing is offered on the Pro+ plan; on Pro, requests go into a shared queue.
gorsel.ipucuNet: • Use a sharp, well-lit, close-up image (avoid blur)

retikulosit.altBaslik: Automatically counts cells from a microscope image.

segmentasyon.altBaslik: Detects the cat's body outline with the YOLOv8-seg model.

gorsel.yanlisFoto: ⚠️ A wrong or blurry photo gives wrong results. A warning is shown if the face cannot be detected clearly.

yuzAgrisi.altBaslik: Analyzes key facial landmarks with the YOLO-pose model.

hastalik.ipucu: Selecting at least 2 symptoms is enough. Entering heart rate, temperature and weight is not required — but if you do, the prediction becomes more distinct (e.g. if the temperature or heart rate is high, the model leans toward a more specific disease).

sonuc.birdenCok: The symptoms point to more than one possible condition; the highest is "{{disease}}" ({{pct}}%). Since confidence is low, it should be clarified with a veterinarian's examination.
sonuc.eslesmeYokMetin: No high-probability disease matched your selected symptoms. You can try again by adding different or more symptoms; if the signs continue, you can consult a veterinarian.
sonuc.siralamaNotu: All probabilities are listed below, sorted by confidence.
sonuc.uyumlu: The entered symptoms best match the "{{disease}}" picture ({{pct}}%). This is a preliminary assessment, not a definitive diagnosis — if the signs continue, an examination by a veterinarian is recommended.
sonuc.yuzdeNotu: Percentage = the model's confidence in that disease; NOT the severity of the disease.

hastalik.varsayilanVital: ℹ️ This prediction assumed healthy cat averages (heart rate ~140, temperature ~38.5°C, weight ~4 kg) for the vitals that were not entered. If you enter the actual measurements, the result will be more accurate.

hata.teshisSirasinda: An error occurred during the diagnosis.

hayvanSahibi.aciklama: Take a photo of your furry friend and let the AI instantly analyze their pain and stress level. If needed, consult your veterinarian.
hayvanSahibi.ipucuIsik: • Use good lighting; eyes, ears and whiskers should be visible
hayvanSahibi.ipucuTekKedi: • Keep only one cat in the frame and avoid blur
hayvanSahibi.ipucuYuz: • Photograph your furry friend's face <kalin>straight on</kalin>, close up and in focus
hayvanSahibi.klinikTelefonuYokGovde: No emergency clinic phone number has been entered in the registration (account) details.
hayvanSahibi.modelHazirlaniyor: Preparing the model, analysis in progress…

oneri.agriYok: No signs of pain or stress are visible in your furry friend's facial features. They look quite relaxed!
oneri.hafif: Your furry friend may have a mild discomfort or tiredness. This may be temporary, but keep observing. If the signs continue, consult your veterinarian.
oneri.orta: Moderate signs of pain or stress were detected! There is noticeable tension in the facial features. If the signs last longer than 1–2 days, consult your veterinarian.
oneri.siddetli: SIGNS OF SEVERE PAIN! Your furry friend may be in serious distress. Please CONTACT YOUR VETERINARIAN WITHOUT DELAY.
oneri.tespitYok: The cat's face could not be clearly detected. Please try again with a clear, well-lit photo taken straight on.

hub.ilkAnalizNotu: ℹ️ The first analysis may take a little longer while the model warms up. Results are a <kalin>preliminary assessment</kalin>, not a definitive diagnosis.
hub.nasilCalisirGovde: <kalin>Tap</kalin> a module → it opens right below; <kalin>you can keep several open at the same time</kalin>. Depending on what you need, use a <kalin>photo or the live camera</kalin>, <kalin>audio</kalin> or <kalin>clinical values</kalin>, then start the analysis. Each module begins with a short usage tip.

kopru.etiket: AI Pro session for this {{hedef}}: go to the Control screen
kopru.ipucu: The session starts only after approval; this button only opens the Control screen.
kopru.metin: ⚡ AI Pro session for this target → Control

fantomTumor.aciklama: Tumor + EM field estimate in a phantom

petriKuyu.aciklama: Cancer + EM field estimate in wells

ortak.modelHazirlaniyor: Preparing the model (the first use may take a while)…
ortak.noktaGorunurluguUyarisi: ℹ️ This model does not report whether facial landmarks are visible: if a region such as an ear or an eye is covered, the score may be misleading — use a photo where the whole face is clearly visible.
ortak.otonomOnayArastirma: Autonomous Biofeedback requires confirmation: get the recommendation from the Control → AI Pro tab and approve it.
ortak.otonomOnayHekim: Autonomous Biofeedback requires veterinarian approval: get the recommendation from the Control → AI Pro tab and approve it.
ortak.tibbiSorumlulukReddi: ⚠️ This AI result is for decision support only; it does not replace a veterinary examination and diagnosis. The final decision rests with the veterinarian.

otonom.baskaSeans: Another session is already active — autonomous drive skipped.
otonom.durdurmakIcin: To stop, use EMERGENCY STOP on the Control screen.
otonom.guncelleniyor: The device is being updated autonomously (once per second)
otonom.ipucu: Autonomous drive starts only through the Control → AI Pro approval flow; this screen does not drive the device
otonom.kimliksiz: Autonomous drive is not performed on a remote request without identity (security).
otonom.onizleme: Preview — device NOT DRIVEN (AI Pro preparation)
otonom.sunucuKamerasiNotu: 🖥️ The server (clinic) camera is running the session — the phone camera is not used
otonom.suruluyor: ⚡ The device is being driven autonomously
otonom.yayinDurduNot: It cannot be confirmed that the session is running. Confirm the status on the Control screen.
otonom.yayinDurduUyari: ⚠️ Live stream stopped — the frame shown is NOT CURRENT

retikulosit.dusuk: The reticulocyte ratio appears to be in the low-to-normal range. If anemia is present it may be non-regenerative; a definitive interpretation requires clinical context.
retikulosit.nokta: The numbers belong to a single microscope field and are not a diagnostic reference range.
retikulosit.yuksek: A relatively high reticulocyte ratio may suggest that the bone marrow is producing new red blood cells (regenerative response — e.g. a reaction to bleeding / anemia). Evaluate it together with the clinical context.

segmentasyon.basarili: Body outlines were extracted successfully. Segmentation is a pre-processing step for measurements and other analyses.
segmentasyon.kediYok: No cat was detected in the image. Try again so that the whole cat fits in the frame.

ses.aciklama: Record your furry friend's meow and let the AI interpret their mood. About 5 seconds in a quiet place is enough.
ses.guvenilirDegil: ⚠️ This result is not reliable — no clear cat sound could be made out in the recording. In a quiet place, bring the microphone closer and record again.

agri.baslik: May Be a Sign of Pain
agri.metin: This sound may be a sign of pain or discomfort. Observe your furry friend closely; if the signs continue, consult your veterinarian.

anneCagrisi.metin: Calling for their kittens or calling out with a mothering instinct — natural behavior.

avOyun.metin: Curious and lively, with an active hunting instinct. Help them burn off energy with play.

ciftlesme.metin: A sound from the mating season. It is natural; if they seem restless, provide a calm environment.

kavga.metin: The sound of a conflict. Move them away from other animals to a safe place.

kizgin.metin: Tense right now. Give them space and don't force them; they may calm down shortly.

mutlu.metin: Your furry friend feels good and happy. Everything looks fine!

savunma.metin: They may feel threatened. Give them a safe space without forcing anything.

uyari.metin: They may be bothered or uneasy about something. Check the surroundings and calm them down.

termal.anormallikMetin: A possible temperature anomaly (may be a focus of inflammation / infection) was detected in the thermal image. Have the area evaluated by a veterinarian.
termal.anormallikYokGuven: No significant thermal anomaly · model confidence {{prob}}%
termal.anormallikYokMetin: No notable anomaly was seen in the thermal distribution.
termal.tespitSatiri: Thermal Detection: <kalin>{{etiket}}</kalin> (Model confidence: {{oran}}% — the model's own confidence in its prediction; not accuracy)

xai.isiHaritasiGenel: 🔍 Heat map — the regions the model looked at (red = strong influence on the decision)
xai.isiHaritasiHasta: 🔍 Heat map — the regions that led the model to the “Sick (At Risk)” decision (red = strong contribution to this decision)
xai.isiHaritasiSaglikli: 🔍 Heat map — the regions that led the model to the “Healthy” decision (red = strong contribution to this decision)
xai.isiHaritasiUret: 🔍 Generate heat map (the regions the model looked at — the analysis takes a bit longer)
